description: A casting director must issue the binding callback package for the lead role in the limited series Ash Harbor, setting the exact audition material, physical exercise, location, schedule, recording controls, and required production follow-ups.

shared_context.S1: Ash Harbor is holding callbacks for its lead role, Mara Quill, with three finalists still under consideration.
shared_context.S2: The draft callback plan uses an excerpt called North Wall, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan places the callback at Studio 4 on June 18 from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
shared_context.S4: Maya has final authority to issue the callback package and call sheet.
shared_context.S5: As part of the production's routine finalization huddle, counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling each review the callback package before Maya issues the call sheet.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the executed streamer casting addendum yesterday; it requires audition footage to be retained for exactly 14 days and accessible only to the named casting team, and he has not entered those terms in the casting tracker yet.

PF2.text: Rhea's safety review of the locked action brief found that finalists must not perform a fall or handle props at callback; the physical portion must instead be an exactly 8-minute grounded choreography exercise supervised by stunt staff, and she has not replaced the draft exercise in the call-sheet template.

PF3.text: Elin received the director's revised brief after the draft packet circulated; it requires Welsh-accented English and the excerpt The Ferry Ledger rather than North Wall, and she has not uploaded the revised brief to the casting folder.

PF4.text: Victor confirmed this morning that Studio 4 is closed for a fire-systems test on June 18; Studio 2 is the available callback room on June 20 from exactly 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM, but the booking change is not yet on the shared calendar.

acceptance_conditions: The callback must use The Ferry Ledger and require Welsh-accented English.
The physical portion must be the supervised 8-minute grounded choreography exercise with no fall or prop handling by finalists.
The callback must move to Studio 2 on June 20 from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
The Studio 2 booking change must be logged on the shared calendar.
Audition footage must be retained for exactly 14 days and limited to the named casting team.
The settlement must log commitments for the safety setup, calendar change, and casting-footage controls.
The revised dialect and excerpt requirement must be cited by Maya.

content_checks.C3: decisions['physical_exercise'] == '8-minute grounded choreography exercise supervised by stunt staff'
content_checks.C4: decisions['callback_room'] == 'Studio 2' and decisions['callback_date'] == 'June 20' and decisions['callback_start_time'] == '1:00 PM' and decisions['callback_end_time'] == '5:00 PM'
content_checks.C6: decisions['physical_exercise_prohibitions'] == 'no falls or prop handling by finalists'
content_checks.C7: any('8-minute grounded choreography' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The executed addendum changes footage retention to exactly 14 days and restricts footage viewers to the named casting team only.
The safety review changes the physical portion to an exactly 8-minute supervised grounded choreography exercise, specifies no falls or prop handling, and requires the corresponding safety commitment.
The revised director brief changes the excerpt from North Wall to The Ferry Ledger and changes the required performance language to Welsh-accented English.
The confirmed room closure changes the callback from Studio 4 on June 18 to Studio 2 on June 20 from exactly 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM and requires that booking change to be logged.
